name: Eritrean Orthodox Tewahedo Church

facts.value: The Oriental Orthodox church of Eritrea, governed by a holy synod of bishops under a patriarch. It traces its origin to Frumentius in the 4th century.

citations.locator: Eritrean Orthodox Tewahedo Church, member profile
citations.excerpt: The Eritrean Orthodox Tewahedo Church was formally founded in 329 AD under the fatherhood of St Frumentius (Abba Selama) the first bishop assigned by St Athanasius, Patriarch of Alexandria.
The church is organized under the supreme body of the holy synod, which is the council of all the bishops and archbishops of the church, presided over by the patriarch

research_notes: No approved source found yet for the date of separation from the Ethiopian church (Eritrean independence 1993, autocephaly 1990s). Britannica.com has it but is not approved. ODCC 2005 should have it.
